newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Three dead as Vietnam cargo ship sinks off HK.
newsitem.headline: Three dead as Vietnam cargo ship sinks off HK.

text.p: Three Vietnamese crewmen are dead and another three missing after 14 men were winched off a sinking cargo ship 460 nautical miles southwest of Hong Kong, the coast guard said on Saturday.

The 518-gross tonne general cargo ship, registered in Vietnam, went down in heavy seas after sending out distress signals on September 18, a spokesman for Hong Kong's Marine Rescue Coordination Centre told Reuters.
The officer said the Vietnamese government had conducted rescue operations, and reported that three of the 20 crew had died, and another three were still missing.
No other details were available, he said.
